traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria for story docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md are satisfied based on concrete implementation and tests.
- Core Functionality: Implemented by src/index.ts exporting a structured ESLint plugin (rules registry and configs). Verified by unit and integration tests: tests/plugin-setup.test.ts, tests/plugin-default-export-and-configs.test.ts, and tests/integration/cli-integration.test.ts, which demonstrate loading, structure, and CLI usage. - Quality Standards: The plugin follows ESLint plugin conventions: TypeScript source compiled to CommonJS, dynamic rule registry, recommended/strict configs, RuleTester-based rule tests elsewhere, and a dedicated development guide. This satisfies REQ-PLUGIN-STRUCTURE, REQ-NPM-PACKAGE, REQ-TYPESCRIPT, and general best-practice expectations. - Integration with ESLint v9 flat config: The plugin exposes flat-config presets (`configs.recommended` and `configs.strict`), and both README.md and user-docs/eslint-9-setup-guide.md include flat-config examples using `traceability.configs.recommended` with ESLint v9. CLI integration tests run ESLint with a flat config that includes the plugin, demonstrating real-world compatibility (REQ-ESLINT-COMPAT, REQ-CONFIG-SYSTEM). - User Experience: README.md provides installation commands, configuration examples, Quick Start, and testing instructions. user-docs/eslint-9-setup-guide.md offers detailed ESLint 9-specific setup and troubleshooting. Together, they give clear instructions on installing, configuring, and using the plugin. - Error Handling: src/index.ts wraps dynamic rule loading in try/catch, logs descriptive errors, and installs a placeholder rule that reports a diagnostic if used. tests/plugin-setup-error.test.ts verifies this behavior; tests/cli-error-handling.test.ts verifies CLI-level behavior and non-zero exit when errors occur. This fulfills the story's Error Handling acceptance criterion and REQ-ERROR-HANDLING. - Documentation: The combination of README.md (user-facing), user-docs/eslint-9-setup-guide.md (user-facing ESLint 9 setup), and docs/eslint-plugin-development-guide.md (developer-facing structure and development guide) covers plugin architecture, configuration, and development setup.
Given this evidence, the foundational ESLint plugin structure specified in 001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP is fully implemented and validated by targeted tests, so the story is assessed as PASSED.
